prompt: Answers about drug interactions are technically right but too dense for new nursing students.
why: Tell the model who it's talking to and what they already know.
trap: The content is right; the level is wrong.

prompt: You want code reviews that catch concurrency bugs the way a senior systems engineer would, not generic style tips.
tells: the way a senior systems engineer would
why: A role sets which expertise and priorities the model brings.
trap: Role alone isn't magic; pair it with what to look for.

prompt: An astronomy app must explain black holes to 8-year-olds.
why: Name the audience so vocabulary and analogies fit.
trap: It's the audience that matters most here.

prompt: The same incident report should be summarized differently for the on-call engineer and for the CEO.
tells: for the on-call engineer and for the CEO
why: Same facts, different audience; state who reads it.
trap: Two prompts differ only in the reader.
